subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Should configured browser-screenshot vision failures permanently use the text-only Option A recovery, or should OpenClaw retain model-visible degraded screenshot recovery through a new session-safe mechanism?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes an existing fallback for configured vision users. Tests and live proof establish the session-safety benefit, but they cannot choose the long-term recovery experience or compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve text-only Option A
options.body: Accept the branch’s text-only failure notice and staged outbound-share path as the configured-vision failure contract.

options.title: Design session-safe Option B
options.body: Keep this PR paused and design model-visible degraded screenshot delivery that cannot be retained in recent tool-result history.

recommendation.title: Approve text-only Option A
recommendation.body: Accept the branch’s text-only failure notice and staged outbound-share path as the configured-vision failure contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented the proposed contract and can incorporate the resulting owner decision, though final browser-owner approval is still needed.
